  • Method Details

    • title

      public MKCMenu.Builder title(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component title)
      The menu's display title. Optional — defaults to "menu.<namespace>.<path>".

    • screen

      public MKCMenu.Builder screen(MKCMenuScreenFactory screenFactory)
      The client screen factory. Optional — defaults to MKCHandledScreen::new. Pass a consumer subclass (MyScreen::new) to wire per-screen hooks (custom keys / listeners / drag modes) in its init(). Never invoked on a dedicated server (see MKCMenuScreenFactory).

    • arm

      public MKCMenu.Builder arm(Runnable arm)
      A behavior-arming hook, invoked by register() after the MenuType + id are live, so a custom menu's slot behavior is armed in the same define chain as the menu it belongs to and cannot be forgotten in a separate pass.

      Arm slot behavior by Address here — the menu's created slots are addressable as soon as it is registered (Window.slot(MKCScreenHandler.address(panelId, groupId, i)).set(...)). Side-neutral: it runs at register() time on whichever side called it (the engine declarations are pure data), exactly like arming behavior by hand in common init. 

      MKCMenu.define(id, MyMenu::buildHandler)
    .screen(MyScreen::new)
    .arm(() -> {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            Window.slot(MKCScreenHandler.address("side", "filtered", i))
                  .set(MKCBehaviorKeys.GATING, diamondsOnly);
        }
    })
    .register();

    • register

      public MKCMenu register()
      Finalises the registration. Side-neutral (common init): builds + registers the MenuType, resolves the default title if none was given, stores the handle in MKCMenu.DEFINITIONS + MKCMenu.BY_ID, and returns it. Call once at mod init.
